Overview

Changzhou is a city in Jiangsu with a population of 5,278,000. A prosperous city in Jiangsu province, known for its dinosaur theme park, textile industry, and solar energy manufacturing. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
